title: From News to Forecast: Integrating Event Analysis in LLM-Based Time Series Forecasting with Reflection
source_locator: arXiv:2409.17515 pp. 1-3 abstract Fig. 1 and method
paper_claim_summary: LLM agents iteratively filter relevant news and evaluate/refine forecasts by integrating selected events with time-series data
harness_scope_assessment: TSK news-driven forecasting harness with reasoning evaluation and reflection

title: Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents
paper_claim_summary: SELA is a neurosymbolic VLM agent using an Event Logic Tree and iterative analyst components for zero-shot event detection
harness_scope_assessment: TSK event-detection harness with symbolic temporal logic and analyst tools

title: ForecastCompass: Guiding Agentic Forecasting with Adaptive Factor Memory
paper_claim_summary: FOCO is an adaptive factor-based memory framework that retrieves task-relevant resolved forecasting experience for agentic forecasting
harness_scope_assessment: General time-series memory harness instantiated for forecasting

title: SIREN: Towards End-to-End Extreme-Weather Early Warning with Experience-Grounded LLM Agents
paper_claim_summary: SIREN combines an agentic execution environment with heterogeneous weather evidence and tools plus retrieval skill distillation and predictive modeling; SIREN-Bench evaluates the warning chain
harness_scope_assessment: TSK weather early-warning harness with reusable memory/skill mechanisms and domain-specific tools
